Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood and we
want to lock in committed spend for FY27. One ask from our finance team: can
Redwood invoice our annual prepay so it aligns with BlueByte's fiscal year (starts
Oct 1)?

Concretely, they'd like: 1) a single annual invoice for the committed amount,
2) an internal drawdown schedule that releases credit to our teams across four
quarters (Oct/Jan/Apr/Jul), and 3) clear VAT routing for our EU entity (we may
need an EU invoice if VAT applies).

Attached is the internal request doc our finance team filled out (requested_payment_terms.pdf).
Can you confirm if Redwood can issue the invoice on Oct 1 and provide a proposed
drawdown CSV we can ingest? Also — any VAT forms you need from us (VAT ID,
W-8/W-9 equivalent)?

Appreciate it — Lina
Lina Park

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear ask and the attachment. Short answer: yes, we can
issue an annual prepay invoice dated Oct 1 and provide a drawdown schedule that
releases credits quarterly to your product teams. A few operational items we need
from you to finalize: 

- Confirm billed entity and remit bank details (legal name + account remittance).
- Provide the EU VAT ID for the entity that should receive the EU invoice (if VAT applies).
- Indicate whether BlueByte prefers a single invoice with internal crediting
  (Redwood issues one invoice to the HQ entity and we route credits), or separate
  country-level invoices (we can do per-entity if you provide tax IDs).

I've attached a draft invoice schedule (CSV) that follows the quarterly release
windows you suggested and includes an example VAT routing column. If you can
review and return with the billed-entity and VAT ID, we'll produce a pro forma
invoice and a DocuSign for signatures.

Next steps I propose:
1) Lina confirms entity + VAT info by Oct 10
2) Redwood issues pro forma by Oct 12 and shares DocuSign
3) On execution, our finance team posts the Oct 1 invoice and we enable the drawdown
   schedule in the console (credits appear per-quarter)

Thanks — I'll flag Marissa for invoicing ops and Jonas for VAT routing.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
